correctness.rationale: A homogeneous ternary quartic has 15 coefficient bits, 32767 nonzero forms. A geometric singular point annihilates the degree-10 Jacobian-ideal map S6⊕(S7)^3→S10; when smooth, three general quartic members of this basepoint-free ideal form a degree-(4,4,4) regular sequence with socle degree 9, proving the rank-66 converse over an algebraic closure and hence F2. For each of seven rational lines the restricted binary quartic is a square precisely when the s^3t and st^3 coefficients vanish. I inspected the complete C++ bit-rank enumerator and independent Python orbit/Groebner source, compiled and ran the 32767-case exact enumerator afresh, reproduced 10920 smooth forms and the entire 8×6 point/bitangent joint table, with bitangent frequencies 3072,5278,2352,105,112,1. Independently checked concurrent bitangent triple and four-line multiplicities from the exact per-subset output; finiteness is the full universe, not a sample.
